_note: What Buzz says on the What is this? page, one speech bubble per entry, in order. Players tap Next to move through them. You can use bold and italics in the text. The last bubble's button says lastButton and goes to lastLink.
bubbles: PLACEHOLDER 1: Hi! I'm Buzz. Welcome to my hive.
PLACEHOLDER 2: Each puzzle gives you seven letters. Make as many words as you can, at least 4 letters long, and always use the center letter.
PLACEHOLDER 3: A pangram uses all seven letters. Finding one is the best feeling in the hive!
PLACEHOLDER 4: Play the Daily puzzle, unlock Puzzles, or race the clock in Pangramble.
PLACEHOLDER 5: Earn Buzz bucks as you play, then spend them on new outfits for me in my chambers!
